posts: Cross-chain swap the intents way: you sign one intent, solvers compete to fill it, settlement finalizes on NEAR. No manual hops, no gas juggling on three chains. #intents #chainabstraction

Solver behaviour note: quotes differ because each solver prices inventory, route risk, and fill time separately. Best execution is the fill that actually clears, not the flashiest number. #near #intents

replies.text: Fair, but intent flow is oddly sentiment-proof — people swap when they need assets moved, bull or bear. Solver fill rates here barely flinched through the quiet weeks.
That rebalance-after-chop flow is exactly what shows up in our order book. Side note: you can source the USDC leg cross-chain as an intent instead of bridging manually first.
